title: Tanese grammar rule file
description: A list of grammar rules, per the rule file format locked in docs/SPEC.md, extended in Phase 1B with the machine-readable fields recorded in docs/CHANGES.md.

allOf.description: Rules that introduce forms must declare them machine-readably, so the contradiction checker can reason about forms instead of prose.
A morphology rule either introduces forms (`morphemes`) or states their arrangement (`slot_order`). One of the two is mandatory: a morphology rule with neither would be prose the checker cannot read.

id.description: Unique, stable rule id, e.g. GR-PART-003.

category.description: The first four of these require `morphemes` (see allOf above): morphology, particle, pronoun, politeness.

alternatives.description: Designs considered and rejected. Same role as in spec/phonology.yaml.

problems.description: Known costs and warts of this rule. Same role as in spec/phonology.yaml.

morphemes.description: Every form this rule introduces. Required for morphology, particle, pronoun and politeness rules.

form.description: The form itself, with no leading hyphen. Must be a phonotactically legal Tanese word and must not appear in spec/grammar_rules/_originality.yaml.

slot.description: For suffixes, one of the verb slots in `slot_order` (or `number` for the noun plural). For particles and words, a free label for the function family, e.g. `case` or `clause`.

function.description: What the form means grammatically. (slot, function) must be claimed by exactly one form across the whole spec.

word_class.description: What this form attaches to. Suffixes of word_class `verb` must sit in a slot named by `slot_order`; a noun suffix need not.

tense.description: Mood suffixes only: whether a verb carrying this mood must also carry a tense suffix. Default `required`; `forbidden` marks a tenseless mood (imperative, hortative, polite request).

slot_order.description: The verb suffix slot order this rule asserts. Every such list in the spec is merged into one partial order; a cycle or a disagreement is a contradiction.

word_boundary.description: Declared by exactly one rule (GR-ORD-001). It is the single definition of `word` used by the tokenizer, the phonotactic validator calls and the script conversion.

asserts.description: Feature keys this rule requires or forbids. A key required by one rule and forbidden by another is a contradiction.

gloss.description: Optional morpheme-by-morpheme gloss, for examples whose structure is not obvious.
